item.title: Read why Allahabad HC granted interim bail to Vibhor Rana accused in Codeine Cough Syrup Case
item.description: The prosecution alleged that the co-accused established bogus firms under different names and that transactions of these firms were carried out by accused Vibhor Rana using the bank IDs and passwords of his associates and employees, thereby facilitating the illegal sale of the cough syrup. The post Read why Allahabad HC granted interim bail to Vibhor Rana accused in Codeine Cough Syrup Case appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Bombay High Court denies bail in Palghar mob lynching case citing gravity of offence and distinct role of accused
item.description: “Liberty of a person accused of an offence would depend upon the exigencies of the case however it is possible that in a given situation, the collective interest of the community may outweigh the right of personal liberty of the individual concerned.” The post Bombay High Court denies bail in Palghar mob lynching case citing gravity of offence and distinct role of accused appeared first on SCC Times.
